## Codex execution contract

**CGS-18 studio-testing and evidence contract:** Use available native tools rather than assuming Claude-specific execution. Preserve current host permissions and prior explicit user authorization; unavailable questions use plain conversation and unanswered decisions are not consent. Native delegation is independent only when a child actually runs; otherwise disclose an in-session fallback. A real human's supplied session observations are the source of playtest findings. New mode returns a blank template and does not fabricate a session. When notes, measured outcomes, duration, build or player feedback are absent, mark them NOT ASSESSED. Distinguish subjective impressions from confirmed defects and never claim a human played based on automated or synthetic tests.
